''See also: [[Forged madra Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Forged]] [[madra]] is a specialized state of energy achieved when a practitioner uses techniques to condense, shape, and solidify [[madra]] into tangible [[constructs]]. This process allows the energy to take on physical properties, such as appearing as blades, shields, [[scales]], armor, or even complex structures like limbs and massive [[stone]] giants. The resulting material can range from fragile, glass-like objects that shatter easily to incredibly dense structures that feel like [[steel]] or [[stone]]. Depending on the skill of the user, [[Forged]] [[madra]] can be used for temporary combat maneuvers—often referred to as [[Forger techniques]]—that dissipate after a few seconds, or it can be crafted into stable, long-lasting items and [[Divine Treasure|Divine Treasures]] through the advanced art of [[Soulsmithing]]. The characteristics of [[Forged]] [[madra]] are heavily influenced by the specific aspect or color of the energy used, such as fire, [[Shadow|shadow]], storm, or [[dream madra]]. While [[pure madra]] is highly adaptable and compatible with most other elements, [[Forged]] [[constructs]] often possess unique properties; some may be liquid in nature, while others might react to light or pressure in unpredictable ways. Advanced practitioners can even imbue these [[constructs]] with temporary life or use them to store and nourish power. However, the act of [[Forging]] can be physically demanding, potentially straining a user's [[madra channels]] or core if done too frequently or without sufficient stability.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Forged]] [[madra]] possesses the unique ability to form dense structures comparable to [[steel]]. During a confrontation, [[Yerin]] successfully deflected a spike composed of this substance. This material can also be utilized to [[construct]] extremely stable barriers. A [[Soulsmith]] must distinguish between the handling of forged [[madra]] and [[dead matter]]. Additionally, a shining bar of this [[madra]] was discovered hidden within a wardrobe.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Forged madra]] can form dense structures like [[steel]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c2">''Soulsmith'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Yerin]] deflected a spike of [[Forged madra]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c3">''Soulsmith'', chapter 3</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Forged madra]] can be used to create extremely stable barriers.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c6">''Soulsmith'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|[[Forged madra]] and [[dead matter]] must be handled differently by a [[Soulsmith]].<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c12">''Soulsmith'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|A shining bar of [[Forged madra]] was found in a wardrobe.<ref name="cradle-02-soulsmith-c18">''Soulsmith'', chapter 18</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Forged]] [[madra]] manifests as a chaotic blend of colors and can exist in various physical forms, ranging from liquid and sludge to pebbles or glass-like shards. This substance is comprised of seven basic [[aspects]] and combinations. It possesses a distinct [[destruction aura]] and can even be utilized to [[construct]] mechanical limbs.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|[[Forged]] [[madra]] is a substance that can be compressed within pouches made of scripted purple cloth. It serves as a component in the construction of barriers, such as those seen in [[Heaven's Glory|Heaven’s Glory]], and can be shaped into transparent, glass-like panes. When these panes are shattered, they burn with the intensity of live coals. This [[madra]] can also be fashioned into solid objects like brown bricks for use as weapons, or manifest as the light emitted from [[Samara's ring]].}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|The [[Heaven's Glory|Heaven’s Glory]] barrier was partially made of [[Forged madra]].<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c6">''Bloodline'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|[[Forged madra]] can be used to create transparent panes of glass-like coverings.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c7">''Bloodline'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|[[Forged madra]] panes burn like live coals when broken.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c7" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|A brick of brown [[Forged madra]] was used as a weapon.<ref name="cradle-09-bloodline-c15">''Bloodline'', chapter 15</ref>}}</li>
